findings_qualitative.value: CMM3A is rich in complex organic molecules in a compact (<300 au) hot core, whereas CMM3B is line-deficient.

evidence.quote: they are concentrated in a compact region ($<300$ au) around the continuum peak

findings_qualitative.value: Two bipolar outflows, from CMM3A and CMM3B respectively.

evidence.quote: This collimated outflow system seems to be launched from CMM3B

evidence.quote: Therefore, the two protostars are most likely gravitationally bound to each other.
